changelog: **Security notices (#1717):** the account owner is told — in-app and by e-mail through the essential `account_security` group, which no preference, quiet hour or unsubscribe can silence — when their account is signed in to from a browser it has not used before, when a superseded "keep me signed in" cookie is replayed (the device is revoked), when the password or the e-mail address changes (the e-mail notice goes to both addresses), when two-factor authentication is turned on or off or its recovery codes are replaced, and when every device is signed out (by them or by an administrator). One sender, `src/lib/securityNotices.ts`, composes all of them in the recipient's language and time zone with the browser label and IP of the request; new `SignInDevice` rows remember an account's browsers (sha256 of the user-agent, 20 per account, forgotten after 180 days) and the first browser is the baseline, so the rollout mails nobody. The rule is pure and unit-tested (`src/lib/signInDeviceRule.ts`); `e2e/security-notices.spec.ts` drives the routes under total opt-out.

en: You now get an e-mail (and an in-app notice) when your account is signed in to from a new browser, when your password or e-mail address changes, when two-factor authentication is turned on or off, when your recovery codes are replaced, or when every device is signed out — even if you have switched all other notifications off.
tr: Hesabına yeni bir tarayıcıdan giriş yapıldığında, parolan veya e-posta adresin değiştiğinde, iki adımlı doğrulama açılıp kapatıldığında, kurtarma kodların yenilendiğinde ya da tüm cihazlardan çıkış yapıldığında artık bir e-posta (ve uygulama içi bildirim) alıyorsun — diğer tüm bildirimleri kapatmış olsan bile.
de: Du erhältst jetzt eine E-Mail (und eine Benachrichtigung in der App), wenn sich jemand aus einem neuen Browser an deinem Konto anmeldet, wenn sich dein Passwort oder deine E-Mail-Adresse ändert, wenn die Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung ein- oder ausgeschaltet wird, wenn deine Wiederherstellungscodes ersetzt werden oder wenn alle Geräte abgemeldet werden — auch wenn du alle anderen Benachrichtigungen ausgeschaltet hast.
